source.final_change: Remove the whole Block / Author / Return metadata strip from history; subsequent OWNER corrections compact history/confirmation and update their text and composition.
latest_owner_corrections: Final red confirmation action: Выполнить возврат; secondary action: Отменить.
Reduce right-side empty space: history maximum width 900px, confirmation 640px; desktop history has two information groups, mobile stacks them.
Read-only history omits Заявок: N.; creation auto-preview retains it.
History and confirmation heading: Перенос заявок #ID with ASCII #; create heading unchanged.
Shared compact-table header/body cells use symmetric 8px vertical and 10px horizontal padding with content-driven height; 8px above the table and 12px modal-body bottom gap.
source.implementation_authorization: OWNER explicitly requested production publication of the accepted transfer popups.

scope: /erpv2/company/feo/requests/transfers — create, preview, history and final revert confirmation

approved.shell: Shared popup title IBM Plex Sans 19/700/22, tracking -0.035em, #131210; cross at right. Existing modal backdrop rgba(10,9,8,.58). Header and footer #F0EDE6. Footer min 48px, top border #DEDAD0, horizontal padding 16px. Body #FEFDF8 with 12px vertical and 16px horizontal padding.
approved.form: Single column, 8px gaps. Requests textarea 96px and vertically resizable, other fields 32px. Existing system radio controls. Order: Requests, destination mode, relevant destination field. No name or comment. Default mode Other request; address mode retains Address and Determine coordinates.
approved.input: Textarea placeholder: Вставьте шестизначные номера заявок. Paste extracts independent six-digit IDs, first tab/markdown column, preserving order and repeated matches, then displays comma-separated values. Ordinary typing is unchanged.
approved.validation: Automatic preview after 250ms with stale-response discard. Missing six-digit request IDs: Заявки не найдены в системе: ID, ID. below Requests; missing target: Заявка не найдена в системе: ID. below target; both use shared field error 11/600 #872822 role=alert. Empty/invalid target: Введите шестизначный номер заявки с нужным адресом. No manual Проверить button. Create action is disabled until current preview token exists.
approved.geocode: No gray read-only fields, copy/map buttons or divider. Found address is full 12/500 text; coordinates share one 12/500 line; static shared badges exact green, number/near/range yellow, street/other red, unknown neutral. Description 11/500.
approved.preview: Plain summary 12/600: Заявок: N. and optional Повторов объединено: D. Full table with standard outer 1px #A8A196 border, internal 300px maximum scroll, columns Заявка / Вес нетто / Было / Станет. Shared compact-table header and body cells have 8px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, content-driven height, 8px preceding gap and 12px body-to-footer gap. Complete addresses wrap; coordinates secondary 11/500 #675F55. One footer action Создать блок и переместить заявки.
approved.history: Heading Перенос заявок #ID (ASCII #) in history and final confirmation; create heading unchanged. Read-only plain text, not disabled form fields. Shared opt-in .registry-ui-modal--reading caps width at 900px; create popup retains 1230px. Shared .registry-ui-modal-grid--reading uses two desktop groups: Requests/target mode/entered address on the left, target request or resolved address/coordinates/quality on the right. The full four-column table spans both groups. If legacy data has no destination fields, omit the empty right group and use one column. At <=700px groups stack in natural reading order. History omits the redundant Заявок: N. summary; create auto-preview retains it. Completed-transfer table columns are Заявка / Вес нетто / Было / Стало. The future create preview retains Заявка / Вес нетто / Было / Станет. In each compact-table body row, all cells align to the top so request ID, weight and addresses start on one horizontal level, with coordinates below their addresses. All request IDs in list/table 12/700 #131210 with tabular numerals. No Блок / Автор / Возврат metadata strip, comment or legacy transfer section. Footer has Отменить and Отменить перенос for active block; returned block has only Отменить.
approved.confirmation: Same heading/shell with shared opt-in .registry-ui-modal--confirmation capped at 640px. Plain 12/500 text lists every request number in 12/700 and says they return to previous addresses and coordinates. Warn that later transfers stop the operation and history remains. Footer Отменить and shared red .btn-danger Выполнить возврат; red is limited to this final destructive confirmation. For many IDs, preserve them all and scroll modal body vertically.
approved.weight: Each row shows current feo_requests.mass_netto converted from tonnes to kg (*1000) with ru-RU maximumFractionDigits 1. Missing request or NULL mass renders neutral —; known zero renders 0 кг. Never divide block total. Weight is display-only and excluded from the existing address/coordinate stale hash.
approved.responsive: At <=700px the nested table is at least 630px wide and scrolls inside its own bordered region, without dialog/document horizontal overflow. Footer buttons wrap without changing typography.

implementation.page_css: public/assets/css/feo-transfers.css retains only pre-existing subject column geometry and the unchanged standalone coordinate-finder rules; new popup styling is owned exclusively by the shared stylesheet
